label: Maximum-first from prior causes: finite controls, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit finite interpretations on Bool and Unit
meaning: Nonvacuity and omission controls: on two beings and one respect, (1) both premises hold with true maximal in being and simply prior to false, and the conclusion holds; (2) with no comparisons and true prior to and causing the being of false, the priority premise holds and the conclusion fails at the maximum false; (3) with no causing and true prior to false, the no-distinct-cause premise holds and the conclusion fails. Finite interpretations only.
